generatedCommentsNodes.comment: In `checkDataStreamMigrationStatus`, the logger and the `ElasticsearchException` use the `migrationInfo` object directly in their messages. Since `SystemDataStreamMigrationInfo` does not override `toString()`, this will result in logging the object's memory address rather than a useful identifier. Use `migrationInfo.getDataStreamName()` or `migrationInfo.getCurrentResourceName()` instead.

review_comment: Why is this no longer needed?

At 1198 of this file `feature.getIndexDescriptors()` has changed to `feature.getSystemResourceDescriptors()` which includes both indices and data streams. The rest of the removed code was essentially the same as there, so now remaining code covers both indices and data streams.
